toolsPreview.name: search_articles

toolsPreview.name: list_articles
toolsPreview.description: Paginated list of articles from Psychiatry for Children. Returns title, slug, summary, and URL.

toolsPreview.name: get_article
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single article from Psychiatry for Children by slug. Returns title, body content, author, clinical reviewer, citations, and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: cite_article
toolsPreview.description: Get a formatted citation for a Psychiatry for Children article. Supports AMA, APA, and Chicago styles.

toolsPreview.name: get_microsite_info
toolsPreview.description: Identity and links for Psychiatry for Children: tagline, audience, focus, publisher, sponsor relationship to Emora Health, and key URLs.
